title: Roveia floating nav pill
description: A white, fully rounded nav pill with a soft 30px shadow floating 24px from the top: wordmark left, a row of links (some with chevrons) that dim to 64% on hover, and a dark pill CTA that turns blue. On phones a slim two-line burger opens a white panel.
notes: fixed by default; pass position="static" to keep it in the flow
the phone menu is a <details> element, so it works without JavaScript
